mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 6-month moving averages, the average 20-day forward return is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change above 2.5%) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, the average 60-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 800 thousand units indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which typically reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 800.0, the average 60-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (when unemployment is below 5.0% and labor market is tight), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals continued economic momentum and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 5.0%), PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly does not produce significantly positive 20-day forward returns (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a recessionary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 5.5, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive years.
